WITH filtered_time_dim AS (
    SELECT t_time_sk FROM time_dim WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
),
filtered_household_demographics AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN filtered_time_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = filtered_time_dim.t_time_sk 
JOIN filtered_household_demographics ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = filtered_household_demographics.hd_demo_sk 
JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
WHERE store.s_store_name = 'ese' 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) 
LIMIT 100
